purpose: Frozen independent native tokenizer observations; Rust replays the complete original model-free input schedule without compiling the retired oracle.

capture.compiler_version: Microsoft (R) C/C++ Optimizing Compiler Version 19.51.36260 for ARM64
capture.expected_outputs_generated_by: Original unmodified C++ bpe.h and tokenizer_oracle.cpp; Rust generated only the existing input schedule, never the expected output.
observations: original loader vocabulary count, EOS ID, reverse spellings and special registration order
every scanner chunk in request order
every encoded token ID in request order including EOS, merge ranks, byte fallback, duplicate vocabulary holes and special-token precedence

inputs.schema: All integers little-endian u32, signed IDs retained as raw bits. Model count; per model: token and merge counted byte-string arrays, counted (key byte-string, ID) pairs, requested-key byte-string array, special (byte-string, ID) pairs, counted (text byte-string, EOS bool u32) requests. Each byte-string is length u32 then exact bytes. No trailing data.

outputs.schema: For each input model: vocabulary count, EOS ID, reverse-spelling counted byte-string array, counted (special byte-string, ID) pairs; for each input request: counted scanner byte-string chunks then counted i32 token IDs. Integers little-endian u32, IDs preserved as raw bits. No trailing data.

qualification_boundary: Historical model-free capture only. Actual pinned vocabulary/model captures, hosted full owning-crate build/link, GGUF loading shim ownership, full-model speech quality, lifecycle and device resource gates remain pending.
